uslaw-usc-t1-s2: Section 2 of Title 1 of the United States Code is a rule on the sense of a word in federal law. Its title states the point: the word county is to be read as taking in parish, and so forth. The section sits in Chapter 1 of the title, on rules for the reading of laws. It thus tells a court how the word county in a law is to be taken. The sense is a wide one, set to fit the terms used in the states.
